name: Historic Tournaments
author: petarku / the5ar (PR #11); the tournaments by Insane (SWOS 2020 DLC, with permission); 1993 Primeira Divisao, 1998 Ligue Pro 1 and the 1994 African Cup of Nations by Taraji
about: Famous tournaments as preset competitions: every World Cup and Euro, the continental cups and the 1990s European Cups (Insane's, from SWOS 2020), Taraji's 1993 Primeira Divisao, 1998 Ligue Pro 1 and 1994 African Cup of Nations, and your own .DIY cups from classic/ in your assets folder.
